headline: Paraguay's President Resigns and Placed Under House Arrest Following Bank Collapse
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña has resigned and been placed under house arrest following the collapse of a government-linked bank that locked citizens out of their savings and sparked protests.
why: Political instability and systemic banking failures in emerging markets can severely disrupt local credit conditions and sovereign risk profiles.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: A presidential resignation and major bank collapse directly destabilize the country's economic and political environment.
